project.name: Share Studio — Complete Feature Suite
project.description: Full Share Studio build-out: smart link polish, one-click static graphic generation, video template pipeline with word-level captions, and animated graphic loops. Proof-item-first architecture with DSL templates, Remotion rendering, async job queue, and REST API. Target: individual professionals (industry agnostic, non-technical). Distribution: download + clipboard + share links (no OAuth social publishing).

epics.name: Smart Links Polish
epics.description: Harden smart links: CTA customization, per-link analytics, mobile polish, bulk operations, and auto-OG image queuing. All stories parallelizable.

epics.name: Static Graphics (Core)
epics.description: One-click review-to-graphic pipeline. DSL template Remotion composition, 4 MVP templates, client-side gallery picker with instant previews, server action to queue multi-format renders, modal flow, polling + download UI, cron worker, and graphics gallery overhaul.

epics.name: Video Templates
epics.description: Deepgram/Gemini word-level STT pipeline, enhanced AnimatedCaptions with real timing, video generation server action, config modal (format, intro/outro, CTA), download + share link UI.

epics.name: Animated Graphics
epics.description: Extend DslTemplate for spring animations (MotionConfig), 4 animated template variants, 'Share as Animation' entry point, CSS animation previews in gallery picker. 3-5s MP4 loops via Remotion.

stories.title: CTA URL + text settings panel in dashboard
stories.description: Add a settings panel to the smart link detail/edit view allowing users to customize the CTA button URL and display text per link. Persist to proof_links table. Default CTA text: 'Get Started'. Validate URL format.
acceptance_criteria: Settings panel renders in smart link edit view with URL input and text input
CTA URL validates as a proper HTTPS URL (or HTTP for local dev)
CTA text has a max length of 40 characters with character counter
Changes persist to proof_links.cta_url and proof_links.cta_text columns
Public smart link page (/s/[slug]) renders the custom CTA button
Default CTA text 'Get Started' is used when field is empty
Negative: empty URL hides CTA button entirely on public page

stories.title: Per-link analytics (views, clicks, referrers, 30-day chart)

acceptance_criteria: Analytics panel renders below smart link detail with views, clicks, CTR percentage

30-day sparkline chart shows daily views and clicks as two lines

Empty state shown when link has zero events
Negative: bot-flagged events (is_bot=true) are excluded from counts
Negative: links with no events show 'No analytics yet' placeholder

stories.title: Landing page mobile polish + reduced-motion + skeleton

acceptance_criteria: All interactive elements have minimum 44x44px tap targets on mobile
Skeleton loading state shows while proof_link data loads (Suspense boundary)
prefers-reduced-motion media query disables any entrance animations
Text passes WCAG AA contrast ratio (4.5:1 for normal, 3:1 for large)

Negative: broken/missing OG image does not crash the page

stories.title: Bulk select/archive/unpublish from smart links table
stories.description: Add multi-select capability to the smart links table. Users can select multiple links and perform bulk archive or unpublish operations. Use checkbox column + floating action bar pattern.
acceptance_criteria: Checkbox column added to smart links table with select-all header checkbox

Bulk unpublish sets is_published=false on all selected proof_links

stories.title: Auto-queue OG image render on smart link creation
stories.description: When a smart link is created via createSmartLink(), automatically queue a proof_render_job with asset_type=smart_link_og. Use the default OG template. Link the resulting proof_asset to proof_links.og_asset_id on completion.
acceptance_criteria: createSmartLink() automatically inserts a proof_render_job row with asset_type=smart_link_og
Render worker picks up the job and renders OG image via Remotion
Completed render creates proof_asset and updates proof_links.og_asset_id
Public smart link page uses the rendered OG image in meta tags
Idempotent: re-creating a link for same proof_item reuses existing OG asset
Negative: failed OG render does not block smart link from being published
Negative: missing template falls back to default brand-colored OG image

stories.title: DslTemplate Remotion composition (DSL to layers to PNG)
stories.description: Create a new Remotion composition (DslTemplate) that reads ShareStudioTemplateDsl JSON and renders each layer (text, shape, image, icon, rating, stats) to a pixel-perfect PNG still. Register compositions for all canvas presets: Square (1080x1080), Story (1080x1920), OG (1200x630).
acceptance_criteria: DslTemplate.tsx Remotion composition renders all 6 layer types (text, shape, image, icon, rating, stats)
Composition registered in Root.tsx for all 3 canvas presets: DslTemplate-Square, DslTemplate-Story, DslTemplate-OG
Text layers support binding resolution via template-resolver.ts
Brand tokens (colors, font, logo) applied from resolved organization settings
Rating layers render star icons at correct scale and color
Stats layers render numeric values with label text
Image layers load remote URLs with fallback placeholder
Output matches canvas dimensions exactly (no scaling artifacts)
Negative: missing binding path renders empty string, not crash
Negative: invalid layer type is skipped with console warning
gates: Remotion studio renders all 3 presets without errors

stories.title: 4 MVP template DSL definitions (migration + seed)
stories.description: Create 4 system-level DSL template definitions and seed them into the proof_templates table via migration: Review Quote Card, Star Rating Card, Stats Summary, Professional Spotlight. Each template defined as ShareStudioTemplateDsl JSON with layers, bindings, and brand token references.
acceptance_criteria: Migration inserts 4 rows into proof_templates with is_system=true
Review Quote Card: customer name, quote text (binding: review_text), star rating, platform icon
Star Rating Card: large rating number, star visualization, review count, reviewer name
Stats Summary: 3-stat grid (avg rating, total reviews, response rate), org logo, tagline
Professional Spotlight: headshot placeholder, name, title, featured quote, star rating
Each template has entries for all 3 canvas presets (square, story, og) as template variants
Brand token bindings (primaryColor, secondaryColor, fontFamily, logoUrl) used in all templates
Negative: templates render correctly with missing optional bindings (e.g., no headshot)
Negative: migration is idempotent (re-running does not create duplicates)

stories.title: Template gallery picker (client-side DSL-to-DOM preview)
stories.description: Build a template gallery picker component that renders DSL templates as DOM elements client-side for instant previews. No server round-trip required for preview. Shows all available templates as thumbnail cards. User taps one to select it for generation.
acceptance_criteria: Gallery renders thumbnail cards for all system templates from proof_templates
dsl-preview-renderer.tsx converts DSL layers to DOM elements with correct positioning
Preview shows the user's actual review data pre-filled via binding resolution
Brand tokens from user's org applied to preview (colors, font)
Selected template highlighted with visual indicator (ring/border)
Gallery is responsive: 2 columns on mobile, 3 on tablet, 4 on desktop
Loading state while templates fetch from server
Negative: template with broken bindings shows placeholder text, not empty card
Negative: gallery with 0 templates shows 'No templates available' message

stories.title: generateGraphicsFromReview server action (queues 3 formats)
stories.description: Create a server action that takes a review_id and template_id and queues 3 proof_render_jobs (square, story, OG) in a single transaction. Idempotent: if proof_item already exists for that review, reuse it. Creates proof_item if needed.
acceptance_criteria: Server action accepts { review_id, template_id } and returns { proof_item_id, job_ids: string[] }
Creates proof_item from review if one does not already exist (idempotent)
Queues exactly 3 proof_render_jobs: asset_type=image for square + story, asset_type=smart_link_og for OG
Each job references the selected template_id and appropriate canvas preset
All DB operations wrapped in a transaction (all-or-nothing)
Returns existing jobs if re-invoked for same review + template combination
Negative: non-existent review_id returns 404 error
Negative: non-existent template_id returns 400 error
Negative: review belonging to different org returns 403 error

stories.title: 'Share as Graphic' button + modal on review detail
stories.description: Add a 'Share as Graphic' button to the review detail page that opens a modal. Modal contains the template gallery picker pre-filled with the review's data. Selecting a template triggers generateGraphicsFromReview and transitions to the render progress view.
acceptance_criteria: Share as Graphic button visible on review detail page (icon: Image + 'Share as Graphic')
Button opens a modal dialog with template gallery picker
Gallery shows templates with the current review's data pre-filled in previews
Clicking a template triggers generateGraphicsFromReview server action
Modal transitions to render progress view showing job status
Button disabled if review has no text content
Loading spinner on button while server action executes
Negative: modal closes cleanly if user clicks outside or presses Escape
Negative: error from server action shown as toast notification, modal stays open

stories.title: Render job polling + download/clipboard/share-link UI
stories.description: Build a render progress component that polls proof_render_jobs status. On completion, show download button, copy-to-clipboard button, and create-share-link button. Progress bar with Zeigarnik effect ('2 of 3 formats generated').
acceptance_criteria: Render progress card shows status of all 3 jobs (square, story, OG) with format labels
Progress bar shows '1 of 3', '2 of 3', '3 of 3 formats generated' as jobs complete
Polling interval: 2 seconds while any job is processing, stops when all complete
Download button generates a direct download link to the rendered asset in storage
Copy-to-clipboard copies the image blob to clipboard (navigator.clipboard.write)
Create share link button triggers createSmartLink for the proof_item
Failed job shows error state with retry button
Negative: all 3 jobs fail shows 'Generation failed' with retry-all button
Negative: user closes modal during polling — no memory leak (cleanup on unmount)

stories.title: Render worker cron trigger (Vercel cron route)
stories.description: Ensure the /api/cron/share-render-jobs cron route is properly configured for Vercel cron. Add vercel.json cron config if missing. Worker processes batch of queued jobs with retry logic and error reporting.
acceptance_criteria: Vercel cron config entry for /api/cron/share-render-jobs (every 1 minute)
Cron route calls processShareRenderJobs() from render-worker.ts
Configurable batch size via query param (default: 5, max: 25)
Returns JSON summary: { processed, completed, failed, requeued, errors }
Authorization: vercel cron secret header or API key required
Failed jobs with retries_remaining > 0 are requeued with backoff
Negative: concurrent cron invocations do not pick up same job (row-level lock)
Negative: job exceeding 5-minute timeout is marked failed with timeout error

stories.title: Graphics tab overhaul (completed asset gallery)
stories.description: Overhaul the Graphics tab in the Share Studio dashboard to show a gallery of completed rendered assets. Grid layout with thumbnail previews, filter by template/format/date, and quick actions (download, copy, share link, delete).
acceptance_criteria: Graphics tab shows a responsive grid gallery of completed proof_assets (asset_type=image)
Each card shows thumbnail preview, template name, format badge (1:1/9:16/OG), and creation date
Filter bar: template dropdown, format toggle (all/square/story/OG), date range picker
Quick actions on each card: download, copy to clipboard, create share link, delete
Delete requires confirmation dialog and removes proof_asset + storage file
Empty state: 'No graphics yet — share a review to get started' with CTA button
Pagination: load 20 at a time with infinite scroll or Load More button

Negative: filter combination with 0 results shows 'No matching graphics' message

stories.title: Deepgram/Gemini word-level STT service
stories.description: Build a transcription service that takes an audio/video URL and returns word-level timestamps using Deepgram (primary) with Gemini as fallback. TikTok-style word-level timing for animated captions.
acceptance_criteria: Service function: transcribeWithWordTimestamps(audioUrl) returns TranscriptionResult
TranscriptionResult includes: full_text, segments[], words[] with { word, start_ms, end_ms, confidence }
Primary: Deepgram Nova-2 API with word_timestamps=true
Fallback: Gemini API with structured JSON output for word-level timing
Automatic fallback if Deepgram fails (network error, rate limit, API key missing)
Confidence threshold: words below 0.5 confidence flagged for review
Supports audio formats: mp3, wav, m4a, webm, mp4
Negative: empty/silent audio returns empty transcript, not error
Negative: audio > 60 minutes returns 413 error with clear message
Negative: invalid audio URL returns 400 with format validation message
gates: Unit tests for fallback logic pass

stories.title: Word-level timestamp data model (migration + types)
stories.description: Add database columns/table to store word-level transcription timestamps alongside video testimonials. Create TypeScript types for the word-level data model.
acceptance_criteria: Migration adds word_timestamps JSONB column to video_responses table (or creates word_timestamps table)
JSONB schema: { words: [{ word: string, start_ms: number, end_ms: number, confidence: number }], model: string, created_at: string }
TypeScript types: WordTimestamp, TranscriptionResult, WordTimestampData
Index on video_response_id for fast lookup
Migration is reversible (down migration drops column/table)
Negative: null word_timestamps means video has not been processed yet (not an error)

stories.title: Enhanced AnimatedCaptions with real word-level timing
stories.description: Upgrade the existing AnimatedCaptions Remotion component to use real word-level timestamps from the STT service instead of estimated timing. TikTok-style karaoke highlighting with word-by-word progression.
acceptance_criteria: AnimatedCaptions accepts wordTimestamps prop (WordTimestamp[] from S301)
Each word highlights at its exact start_ms timestamp (karaoke-style)
Active word styled with scale(1.1) + brand primaryColor highlight
Words before active word styled as completed (dimmed)
Words after active word styled as upcoming (normal opacity)
Smooth transitions between words using Remotion's interpolate()
Line breaks inserted intelligently (max 3-4 words per line for readability)
Falls back to estimated timing when wordTimestamps prop is null/undefined
Negative: words with 0ms duration are treated as instantaneous (no animation)
Negative: overlapping word timestamps handled gracefully (use start_ms only)
gates: Remotion studio preview shows correct word-level timing

stories.title: generateVideoFromTestimonial server action
stories.description: Create a server action that takes a video_response_id, transcribes it (if not already), and queues a proof_render_job for video generation. Supports format selection (16:9, 1:1, 9:16). Creates proof_item if needed.
acceptance_criteria: Server action accepts { video_response_id, format, template_config }

template_config supports: include_intro (bool), include_outro (bool), cta_text (string)
Returns { proof_item_id, job_id, transcription_status }

Negative: transcription failure queues job anyway with estimated timing fallback
Negative: video_response belonging to different org returns 403

stories.title: Video template config modal (format, intro/outro, CTA)
stories.description: Build a modal for configuring video template options before generation. User selects aspect ratio, toggles intro/outro, sets CTA text, and previews settings before triggering render.
acceptance_criteria: Modal opens from 'Share as Video' button on video testimonial detail page
Format picker: 16:9 (Landscape), 1:1 (Square), 9:16 (Portrait/Stories) with visual indicators
Toggle switches for: Include branded intro, Include branded outro
CTA text input with 40-char max and character counter

Generate button triggers generateVideoFromTestimonial and transitions to progress view
Default selections: 9:16, intro on, outro on, CTA from org settings

stories.title: Video download + share link UI
stories.description: Reuse and extend the render progress card (S205) for video assets. Add video-specific features: inline video preview player, download as MP4, and create share link.
acceptance_criteria: Render progress card works for asset_type=video jobs (single job, not 3)
On completion: inline video preview player with play/pause controls
Download button triggers MP4 file download with descriptive filename
Create share link button creates a smart link pointing to the video proof_item
Share link OG meta includes video:type and video:url for social platforms

stories.title: Extend DslTemplate for MotionConfig (spring animations)
stories.description: Extend the DslTemplate Remotion composition to support motion presets. Add MotionConfig to template-types.ts DSL schema. Each layer can specify entrance animation (fade, fade-up, slide-left, zoom-in) with spring physics and stagger delays.
acceptance_criteria: MotionConfig type added to ShareStudioTemplateDsl: { preset, delay_ms, duration_ms, spring }
DslTemplate renders layers with Remotion spring() animations when motion config present
Supported presets: fade, fade-up, fade-down, slide-left, slide-right, zoom-in, zoom-out
Spring physics configurable: damping, stiffness, mass (sensible defaults provided)
Stagger delays: each layer can have independent delay_ms for sequenced entrance
Animated output renders as 3-5 second MP4 loops (90-150 frames at 30fps)
Layers without motion config render statically (backwards compatible)
Negative: invalid motion preset falls back to 'fade' with console warning
Negative: total animation duration exceeding 5s is clamped to 5s
gates: Remotion studio renders animated compositions smoothly

stories.title: 4 animated template variants (motion-enabled DSL)
stories.description: Create animated variants of the 4 MVP templates from S201. Each variant adds MotionConfig to layers for entrance animations. Seed into proof_templates with is_animated=true flag.
acceptance_criteria: Migration inserts 4 animated template rows into proof_templates with is_animated=true
Animated Review Quote: quote text fade-up → stars zoom-in → name slide-right (staggered)
Animated Star Rating: rating number zoom-in → stars sequential fade → reviewer slide-up
Animated Stats Summary: each stat counter zoom-in with stagger → logo fade → tagline slide-up
Animated Professional Spotlight: headshot zoom-in → name/title slide-right → quote fade-up → rating fade
All animations complete within 3-5 seconds (loop-friendly)
Each animated template has square (1080x1080) and story (1080x1920) variants
Negative: rendering animated template as still (PNG) ignores motion config, outputs first frame
Negative: migration is idempotent

stories.title: 'Share as Animation' entry point + modal tab
stories.description: Add a 'Share as Animation' tab or toggle within the generate graphic modal (S204). When animation mode is selected, gallery shows only animated templates. Generation queues video render jobs (MP4) instead of image jobs.
acceptance_criteria: Tab or toggle in generate graphic modal: 'Static' | 'Animated'

Output is 3-5 second looping MP4 at 30fps

stories.title: CSS animation preview in template gallery picker
stories.description: Add CSS-based animation previews to the template gallery picker for animated templates. When hovering/focusing an animated template card, play a CSS approximation of the entrance animations. No Remotion needed for preview.
acceptance_criteria: Animated template cards in gallery show a play icon overlay
On hover (desktop) or tap (mobile), CSS animations play simulating the entrance sequence
CSS animations approximate the MotionConfig: fade → opacity, slide → translateX/Y, zoom → scale
Stagger delays from DSL mapped to CSS animation-delay values
Animation plays once on trigger, resets on mouse leave / second tap
Static templates show no play icon and have no hover animation
Performance: CSS animations only, no JavaScript animation libraries needed
Negative: prefers-reduced-motion disables animation preview, shows static card
Negative: template with missing motion config treated as static (no play icon)

zeigarnik_effect.principle: People remember incomplete tasks better than complete ones
zeigarnik_effect.application: '3 of 3 formats generated' progress bar in render progress card (S205)

endowment_effect.principle: People value things more when they feel ownership
endowment_effect.application: Gallery previews show YOUR review data pre-filled in templates (S202)

ikea_effect.principle: People value things they helped create
ikea_effect.application: Choosing a template is a micro-investment that increases perceived value (S204)

mimetic_desire.principle: People want what others demonstrate wanting
mimetic_desire.application: 'Your reviews deserve this spotlight' footer CTA in share studio dashboard

activation_energy.principle: Lower the starting friction to near-zero
activation_energy.application: One-click flow: review → tap template → auto-generate 3 formats (S203, S204)

goal_gradient.principle: People accelerate toward a goal as they get closer
goal_gradient.application: Progress indicators accelerate visually as renders complete (S205)
